_comment: NT8 bridge test harness configuration. All paths must match what the NT8 strategy is configured to use.
_skip_groups_note: Set to ['C'] to skip heartbeat tests (C-01/C-02) which disable intake and take 30+ seconds.

phase2._comment: Phase 2 settings: requires DryRunMode=false, Sim101 account, live ticks.
phase2._bracket_note: 50-tick stop stays within the runner template cap and shell max stop cap; 200-tick target keeps targets from firing during lifecycle tests.
phase2._settle_note: post_flat_settle_seconds: brief pause after flat-confirmation so NT8 finishes bracket-cancel I/O before next entry.
phase2._entry_qty_note: Set entry_qty >= 2 to enable partial-exit tests (P2-C02, P2-C03, P2-C04).
phase2._fill_wait_note: Increase fill_wait_seconds if the Sim fills are slow on replay.
phase2._checkpoints_note: Set show_checkpoints=false for fully unattended runs (SEMI_AUTOMATED steps auto-pass).

_notes: bridge_root must match InboxDirectory parent in NT8 strategy parameters.
Phase 1: NT8 strategy must have DryRunMode=true and EnableOutboxEvents=true.
Phase 2: NT8 strategy must have DryRunMode=false, EnableOutboxEvents=true, Account=Sim101.
Run during market hours when the chart receives live ticks.
Heartbeat tests (Phase 1 Group C, Phase 2 Group F) run last -- restart strategy after.
Adjust heartbeat_timeout_seconds to match HeartbeatTimeoutSeconds in NT8.
Phase 2 shell changes required: SHELL_READY event, enriched FILLED/STOP_ATTACHED, STOP_WORKING event.
